HCL.label: Hardcore Ladder
HCL.tagline: Full games. No hustle. No hassle.
intro: You make your game and I fill it up: **players 8, in seconds**.
**More** monsters, **more** experience, **more** drops, every single run.
No lobbies to search, no one to wait for, no babysitting. You play your runs at your own pace, and the game is always full.
**Run like you're offline, with a full game around you.**
Set up once in a couple of minutes. After that it is there **any time you want to play**, day or night. Start when you like, stop when you're done.
chips: Your game | your rules your loot
HCL.needs_intro: Items I need - donations or trade for time

pricing.name: Short expiry
pricing.note: 10h pack, use it sooner for less

HCL.free: First hour is free for new players. Try it and feel the speed.
HCL.cta: Register once • Play any time • End whenever
HCL.contact: DM on JSP, comment this topic or join the Discord to register and start.
pricing_text: **Hours are for a full team**: Bobarb + 6 fillers. A smaller team pays only for its slots: Bobarb is 1/5 of the price, each filler 2/15.
**The bigger the pack, the cheaper the hour**: 500 FG for 1 h, down to 175 FG per hour from 40 h.
**Choose hours valid for a shorter period**: 6 months is the full price, 1 day is 55% off.
